notes: Private commercial tenant improvement in Austin, Texas. Contractor: Meridian Builders, Inc., an Oakland, California contractor registered to do business in Texas. Subcontractor: Lone Star Mechanical, LLC of Round Rock, Texas (HVAC and plumbing). Owner: Brazos Property Partners, LP. Project: Congress Avenue Office TI, 800 Congress Avenue, Austin, Texas 78701. The Subcontract Sum is exactly $360,000.00. The Schedule of Values has exactly these five lines: Mobilization and submittals $18,000.00; Ductwork and air distribution $120,000.00; Rooftop units and controls $110,000.00; Plumbing rough-in and fixtures $82,000.00; Testing, balancing and closeout $30,000.00.
brief: This is a private (not public) project governed by Texas law. Payment clause: Contractor's receipt of payment from Owner is an express condition precedent to Contractor's obligation to pay Subcontractor, and Subcontractor assumes the risk of Owner's nonpayment (a pay-if-paid clause); when Contractor is paid, it pays Subcontractor within thirty (30) days after receipt. Retainage is ten percent (10%). Lien waivers must be in the forms prescribed by Texas Property Code Section 53.284.

retainage.release_condition: Final Completion of the Subcontract Work and Contractor's receipt of retainage from Owner

anomalies.description: Owner payment is a condition precedent to any payment to Subcontractor (pay-if-paid).
